meta.description: Why Dentalpin exists and what we promise the dental industry: open, modular, calm software. For clinics who've been waiting years for something better.

manifestoPage.title: The software that brought the sector this far isn't the one that will take it to the next place.
manifestoPage.lead: We've been working alongside the dental sector for years and we know what software has given it: clinics that invoice, schedule and look after patient histories in seconds where once there were folders and phone calls. Part of the reason the sector is today one of the most professionalised in the world is thanks to those programs that brought us here. But that first generation can't stretch any further: interfaces that haven't been rethought in fifteen years, migrations that turn impossible the moment a clinic wants to grow, data that's painful to export, and licensing models that fit some clinics and suffocate others. The sector is ready for a new leap, one that keeps the wins of the previous generation and adds everything 2026 makes possible. This manifesto is our way of pushing that leap, with respect for what has been built and ambition for what's still missing.

sections.heading: What we've been seeing for years
sections.body: We've seen dentists lean on their management software for years to remember appointments, keep patient histories and invoice with rigour. What feels obvious today, the whole patient one click away, is something those programs genuinely achieved, and it deserves credit. But we've also seen those same professionals open the screen and sense the day is about to drag; receptionists who hang up the phone to wrestle a search box; owners who discover that exporting their own database costs a multi-digit invoice and a six-week wait. It isn't that the sector chose badly: it's that the alternative hadn't been built yet. Until now.

sections.heading: What we believe
sections.body: We believe in free software, and in the idea that there should exist an open alternative where a clinic can manage its patients' data. We believe a program a hygienist will open fifty times a day deserves to be beautiful, fast and well designed. We believe a clinic owner should be able to decide whether to keep their data in the cloud or on a server inside the clinic. We believe code that handles health data should be readable, auditable and discussable in broad daylight. We believe AI will transform this sector, for the better, only if it's built with humans at the wheel. And we believe no dentist in Santiago, Bogotá, New York, Madrid or Lisbon should wait five years for software to "reach their market".

sections.heading: What we promise you
sections.body: We won't sell you plans or per-user seats. We won't raise your price when you grow. We won't hide features behind "contact sales". We won't lock you into our servers. We won't close the source when things go well. And we promise that what you use today will still exist tomorrow. Because it lives on GitHub, because anyone can keep it alive, because it doesn't depend on us staying around.

sections.heading: What we ask from you
sections.body: If you like Dentalpin and it saves you a few hours this week, tell another clinic. If you find a bug, open an issue on GitHub. If you're missing a module, describe it and someone (you, us or the community) will build it. If you speak another language, translate it. If you try it and it's not for you, write us with all the love in the world: feedback makes us better. This isn't a company selling you a product. It's a community building the infrastructure a whole sector needs.

sections.heading: Where we're going
sections.body: We want that, in five years, opening a new clinic will be about deciding what to do with your patients, not which software to avoid. We want the next generation of dentists to learn on a system that helps them and respects their time. We want dental practice management software to stop being a problem and to finally become, at last, invisible, like electricity or hot water.

manifestoPage.closing: This is Dentalpin. If you've read this far, you might never look at your clinic's software the same way again.

bento.title: Built for how a clinic actually works
bento.subtitle: Every feature is a module. Turn it on, turn it off or replace it whenever you want.

modular.title: A small core. Modules that plug in.
modular.body: The module system isn't a metaphor: each one ships a manifest, its own Alembic migration branch, YAML seeds, auto-registered navigation and an event bus subscription. Turn on what your clinic needs, ignore the rest, and if something is missing — build it and plug it in.
modular.communityNote: On the way. Build them yourself or join who is already shipping them.

demo.title: Try it yourself, no install needed.
demo.body: We spin up a sample clinic in your browser, already filled with patients and appointments. Have a look around, book an appointment, draft a quote. No sign-up, no email required, nothing to download.
steps: Click the "Open the demo" button. It opens in a new tab.
Sign in with the username and password shown below.
Click around freely: patients, calendar, quotes, invoices…

credentials.label: Use these to log in
credentials.rolesNote: There are also dentist, hygienist, assistant and reception logins. Same password for all of them.

demo.disclaimer: We wipe everything every night. Don't upload real patient data.
demo.noInstall: Works on any computer, tablet or phone. All you need is a browser.

stack.title: A modern, deliberately boring stack.
stack.body: We pick what serious teams pick. Nothing exotic, nothing legacy.

oss.title: BSL 1.1 today. Apache 2.0 tomorrow.
oss.body: Dentalpin ships under Business Source License 1.1: free for any clinic, free to read, fork, contribute and build modules on top. The only line in the sand: you can't launch Dentalpin as a competing dental SaaS. After four years, each release flips automatically to Apache 2.0.

sponsors.title: Dentalpin runs on its community.
sponsors.body: If Dentalpin saves you hours every week, here are a few ways to give back:

items.a: Business Source License. Free for any clinic, free for any dev. The only restriction: you can't launch Dentalpin as a competing dental SaaS. After four years, each release flips automatically to Apache 2.0.

items.q: Can I resell it as SaaS?
items.a: Not as a competing dental practice management SaaS while the license is BSL. Anything else is fair game: implementation services, private hosting, support, custom modules.
Clone the repo, copy the .env, run docker compose up. The docs cover the rest. On a reasonable VPS, under thirty minutes.

items.q: What if my clinic is tiny?
items.a: Even better. Dentalpin runs comfortably on a €4/month VPS. No minimum users, no monthly invoices to babysit.

items.q: What if I need serious help?
items.a: That's what the optional services above are for: guided setup, annual support, custom modules.
